rationale: The earlier per-entry revision prevented different-key overwrites but still used a non-atomic read-then-write for the same receipt status. A simultaneous withdrawn write could be overwritten by a stale accepted write. Also manual queue dispatch did not recheck the permission epoch immediately before fetch. Both observations were independently reported before this checkpoint; they affect withdrawal-state fidelity and explicit stop semantics. Current frozen revision adds an independent monotonic withdrawal marker and the epoch check for every queued POST, which addresses these observed branches statically.
